sources.note: Main vendor homepage. Describes Althea Smart EHR as AI-powered mobile EHR, lists key features (voice-to-text, telemedicine, eRx, patient portal, kiosk, labs, HIE), lists supported specialties. Also references mds:practice as separate PM product.
ONC mandatory disclosures page. Confirms Althea Smart EHR Version 3.0 certification, lists 40+ certified criteria, states no hidden costs or limitations. Mentions 16 CMS quality measures.

Feature marketing page. Describes AI-powered ambient listening for documentation, voice-to-text, smart phrases, mobile iOS access, telemedicine, EPCS, integrated labs/radiology, HIE, billing, analytics, patient portal, kiosk, cloud fax, patient texting, internal chat.

Patient portal feature page. Describes payment collection, patient demographic self-updates, electronic forms and consents, remote check-in, messaging, and Apple Health app data sharing with providers.

Interfaces/integrations page. Lists specific integrations: Quest Diagnostics, Labcorp, Sonora Quest (labs); Change Healthcare, Emdeon, Office Ally, Trizetto, Waystar (clearinghouses); Surescripts, NewCrop (e-prescribing); Aledade, Apple, Providence, Rivet Health (HIE); Twilio (SMS); Zoom (telemedicine); ZocDoc (scheduling); state immunization registries. All via HL7.

mds:practice feature page. Describes real-time multi-location scheduling, clearinghouse billing integrations, ERA posting, denial tracking, insurance verification, patient statements via BillFlash, HIPAA-compliant telemedicine, patient SMS messaging.

mds:practice overview page. Positions PM as 'backbone of operations.' Three areas: patient scheduling (appointments, check-in/out, visit patterns, payments, reminders), patient statements (direct print or BillFlash, 6 formats), advanced billing (clearinghouse integrations).

Third-party profile. Lists features: scheduling, e-prescriptions, patient portal, compliance tracking, document management, lab integration, telemedicine, mobile access, reporting/analytics, billing, eligibility verification, claims management, referral management. Pricing tiers: Basic $200, Standard $540, Premium $640, Enterprise custom.
Third-party product profile. Notes Althea Speech powered by Nuance for medical speech recognition. Categorized under EHR and telemedicine. Limited additional detail beyond marketing positioning.
Third-party review site (403 blocked on fetch but appeared in search results). Listed Althea Smart EHR with reviews and pricing info.
Third-party review site (403 blocked on fetch). Search results indicated positive user reviews praising iPad usability, dictation, and customizability for different specialties.
